transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, November 11. transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Coded calls from Brooklyn jail: How Iran operative directed terror plots in Europe, US. A US indictment alleges that an Iran-backed operative jailed in New York used coded calls with family members to coordinate a plot against RAF Fairford, a British air base housing US troops. The accused and two associates are also alleged to have planned nearly 20 attacks targeting Jewish communities across Europe and the US. MEA slams US court summons to Doval, RAW ex-chief Goel. 'Pannun's Lawsuit Frivolous, His Claims Fabricated' Assaulted in Tihar jail, denied treatment, claims US national Matthew VanDyke. Matthew VanDyke alleged that he experienced assaults during his time in Tihar jail while awaiting trial. He claimed he was physically attacked and denied medical attention by prison authorities. VanDyke, along with six Ukrainians, faced accusations of connections to armed groups in Myanmar. He was granted bail due to an incomplete chargesheet from the National Investigation Agency. Google CEO sends welcome note to Zuckerberg: Excited to serve our Cloud customer. Meta's Muse Ember, Muse Spark 1.3, and Muse Wonder are now available through Google Cloud's managed APIs. These models are designed for various complex tasks including software engineering, workflow automation, and document processing. Google CEO Sundar Pichai welcomed the collaboration, which integrates Meta's AI with Google Cloud offerings. Muse Ember emphasizes efficiency and cost-effectiveness for daily tasks across different applications. India hits immunisation milestones, but why are many still missing their shots?. India's vigorous vaccination campaigns have made remarkable strides in eliminating diseases such as smallpox and polio. Yet, disparities still exist in immunization coverage between various states and communities. Current initiatives aim to enhance accessibility and monitoring of vaccinations, especially addressing caregiver hesitancy and obstacles encountered by migrants. Raising awareness and consistent follow-up will be vital in boosting vaccination rates in the future. 16-year-old builds real-life Jarvis to control his home with voice. A young innovator has created a voice-activated home automation system reminiscent of Iron Man's JARVIS. This invention empowers users to manage their lighting effortlessly through voice commands, eliminating the hassle of reaching for switches. It's an excellent solution for the elderly and those with mobility challenges, showcasing the exciting intersection of technology and daily life, making modern homes smarter and more accessible. 80 percent of Delhi's pollution Monday due to crackers. Firecracker emissions accounted for more than 80 percent of Delhi's pollution load on Monday, a day after Diwali, according to the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology's models, highlighting the sharp impact of fireworks on the capital's air quality. 28-day challenge: A heart scan made me give up everything I loved. Eleven years of experiments on myself, and my numbers are better now than when I was suffering. Here is what I got wrong. US House blocks bid to impeach war secretary Pete Hegseth. House Republican leaders and White House officials on Tuesday night blocked an effort to impeach US secretary of war Pete Hegseth, securing a procedural victory for President Donald Trump. What Nvidia CEO first told world about the woman he has admitted having an affair with. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly acknowledged an affair that has raised concerns over his leadership. Following his admission, Nvidia initiated an independent investigation into reports concerning foreign intelligence involvement. Huang expressed remorse for his actions towards his family and colleagues while committing to cooperate with the inquiry. US President Donald Trump commented on the situation, stating that the FBI is investigating the matter. Indiana couple disputes modular home bill; court upholds $221,000 judgment. An Indiana couple withheld the remaining payment for a $211,235 modular home, citing construction problems. The Indiana Court of Appeals upheld a $221,704 judgment against them, finding that the builder had substantially performed its contractual obligations and that the couple had prevented it from completing the remaining work. Before J and K blast, how a plan to bury explosives in Faridabad village was buried. An explosion occurred at the Nowgam police station in Srinagar, killing nine individuals including law enforcement and forensic personnel. This explosion was linked to explosives moved from Haryana to Jammu and Kashmir for criminal investigation. The explosives had been seized in connection with a terror module involving Al

How to check and report shortfalls. Salary-slip deductions do not guarantee that employers deposit provident fund contributions. Here's how employees can check the status and report discrepancies, if any. Salary credited? 5 smart ways to manage monthly expenses, build savings and start investing from your first job. Your first salary is an opportunity to build sound financial habits. From budgeting and creating an emergency fund to buying health insurance, managing credit cards and starting SIPs, here are five money decisions young earners should make early. Banks open or closed tomorrow, 11 Nov 2026? Check closures in Kanpur, Lucknow, Shimla, Kolkata, Gangtok and Imphal. Banks will be closed in Gangtok, Imphal, Kanpur, Kolkata, Lucknow and Shimla on Wednesday, November 11, for regional festivals. Details here. Delayed PF deposits? EPFO offers lower penalties under VISHWAS 2026 scheme, but employers must apply by 28 December. EPFO's VISHWAS 2026 scheme allows eligible employers to settle pending PF damage disputes at reduced rates, starting at 0.25 percent per month. The one-time settlement window closes on 28 December 2026. Interest and PF contributions remain payable. 8th Pay Commission: rupees 69,000 minimum basic pay, higher HRA and increment rate , What changes NC-JCM seek?. The NC-JCM has proposed major changes for central government employees under the 8th Pay Commission, including higher minimum pay, 6 percent annual increments, increased pensions and allowances, and doubling leave encashment to 600 days. EPS pension hike: EPFO shifts venue of November 19 CBT meeting to Delhi; will government approve rupees 3,000 minimum pension?. EPFO has shifted the venue of its 240th CBT meeting on 19 November from Gujarat to New Delhi. The meeting comes amid media reports suggesting a possible increase in the minimum EPS pension from rupees 1,000 to rupees 3,000. Foreign equities under pressure: what should investors do?. Indian investors are looking beyond domestic equities, but recent overseas market corrections underline why global exposure should be a long-term diversification strategy, not a bet on past returns. How travellers are working around pricey flights for winter holidays. Travellers are finding creative ways to preserve their winter holidays despite soaring airfares. Some are swapping flights for trains and road trips, while others are choosing domestic destinations over international ones. Bhai Dooj 2026 financial gift: Gold ETFs for your sibling? How it differs from mutual funds? Process, rules explained. With Bhai Dooj around the corner, consider gifting your sibling gold ETFs instead of traditional gold. Know how to transfer ETF units through demat accounts, how gifting differs from mutual funds, the available transfer routes, costs and tax implications. Wrong details in PF account can delay your money; EPFO explains how to correct them online in 5 easy steps. Incorrect personal or employment details in your EPF account could create hurdles when withdrawing money, transferring PF balance, or settling claims. EPFO has highlighted its Joint Declaration facility, allowing members to request corrections to their records through the Member Portal.

transcript.title: Science and technology
transcript.text: Next, science and technology. Banks seek to rein in soaring AI agent costs, McKinsey says. BANKS-AI/SUR Microsoft's DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode. Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today. Auto SR is also getting some new features alongside this official release. In April, Microsoft started testing Auto SR X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement. X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral. Scientists discover a giant 66-pound rodent that lived 34 million years ago. Scientists have uncovered fossils of a giant rodent that lived in Thailand 34 million years ago, revealing that enormous rodents evolved much earlier than previously thought. Named Yakamys sirindhornae, the ancient animal may have weighed around 66 pounds, roughly twice as much as other known rodents of its time. The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies. Disney is bringing more than 60 3D movies to the Disney Plus app on Meta Quest. The movies will be available to Disney Plus subscribers as part of an updated Disney Plus app that's rolling out today. The 3D movies you can check out include The Avengers and Black Panther, Meta says. But the updated OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder. OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry. Why heart attacks can still happen even when bad cholesterol is low. Even when bad cholesterol is brought down to healthy levels, some people remain at risk of heart attacks, and scientists may have discovered why. Researchers identified two types of fat-carrying particles that appear to promote inflammation and damage blood vessels through mechanisms beyond cholesterol buildup. Entered a fake birthday on Instagram? Meta's AI can now identify users posing as adults. Meta is expanding its AI-powered age-detection technology globally to identify teenagers who use fake birth dates to appear as adults on Instagram. The move will place more users aged 13 to 17 under Teen Account safety settings, while Meta is also introducing Apple's age-range signal in Australia. Oura is acquiring medical AI chatbot startup Counsel Health. Oura announced its quarterly earnings today and said it agreed to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million, after adding the company's AI chatbot to its app earlier this year. Counsel Health calls itself an "AI-native primary care company," using the app to deliver AI-generated responses and insights based on users' health data reported from their OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York's AI safety law takes effect. New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines. 237-million-year-old fossils reveal a bizarre armored sea amphibian. A bizarre, heavily armored amphibian roamed the oceans 237 million years ago, despite the fact that modern amphibians cannot survive entirely in saltwater. Discovered in China, the giant salamander-sized creature may be the first known amphibian to have adapted to a fully marine existence. GTA 6 release date confirmed for November 19: Pre-load, New Zealand early access, PC update and £1 million car. Rockstar Games has confirmed November 19, 2026, as the GTA 6 release date, with digital pre-loading starting November 10 for PS5 and Xbox Series X S. Ahead of launch, reports detail New Zealand's early access, the unconfirmed PC version and a real-life GTA-inspired Grotti Cheetah. Sony cancels live-service shooter Fairgames. Sony has canceled Fairgames, a heist game announced in 2023, according to Bloomberg. Fairgames had once been part of Sony's big planned push for PlayStation live service games, but the company ended up canceling some planned live service titles, including in the God of War and The Last of Us franchises, and it shut down Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development. Former SignalFire investor Sahir Raoof raises $27.5 million for new fund targeting AI in pharma. NASA's CHAPEA Mars crew finally emerges after more than a year in isolation. After more than a year of simulated life on Mars, four NASA volunteers have finally emerged from isolation, bringing a remarkable space exploration experiment to an end. Their experiences growing food, conserving resources, and overcoming Mars-like challenges could help NASA prepare for humanity's future on the Moon and Mars. Apple introduces $50 AI usage packs for Creator Studio apps: What users get and how they work. Apple has introduced $49.99 one-time AI usage packs for Creator Studio subscribers who exhaust their free monthly limits, starting with Logic Pro. Available in India and seven other countries, the packs offer 12-month validity. The PlayStation Plus PC app is shutting down next month. Sony is retiring the PlayStation Plus app for PC on December 10th. Sony says it will notify users directly about the shutdown. The app allowed PlayStation Plus Premium subscribers to stream certain games on PC, but according to Sony, not many people are using that perk: With a very small number of eligible PlayStation Plus X-energy gets green light to build its first small modular nuclear reactors. X-energy received a construction permit from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to build four reactors in Texas. NASA offers $500,000 to develop next-generation electric rocket engines. NASA is putting $500,000 on the line in a new competition to accelerate the development of advanced electric rocket engines for satellites and future space exploration. The AMPERE Challenge will reward up to two U.S. companies with cash prizes and access to NASA testing facilities to help bring promising propulsion technology closer to real-world missions. AI could eliminate up to 70 percent of manual risk tasks in banks, free capacity for strategic roles: McKinsey. Artificial intelligence could eliminate 60-70 per cent of manual operational tasks in banks' risk functions, allowing lenders to redirect resources towards deeper risk analysis, strategic decision-making and AI development, according to a report by McKinsey. Starlink Mini 2 adds a swappable battery. SpaceX announced a new version of its all-in-one satellite internet terminal that integrates a dish, Wi-Fi router, and now a battery into a single device about the size of a laptop. According to some users on X who shared screenshots of invitations to order Starlink Mini 2, the dish is priced at $999, which includes All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO. Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company. Global fossil fuel emissions set to fall in 2026, but total CO2 keeps rising. Global fossil fuel emissions are projected to fall in 2026 as renewable energy and electric vehicles gain ground, but rising emissions from deforestation threaten to push total CO2 emissions to a new record. Scientists warn that the world's remaining carbon budget for limiting warming to 1.5°C could be exhausted in less than four years, even as a lasting decline in emissions appears increasingly within reach. The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it. As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world's most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs, and all manner of important people. He also wears a cool leather jacket. Which makes Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M. The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing "uncertainty in the IPO market." Google's Pixel Tag tracker is now available. After years of third-party Android trackers from companies like Samsung, Motorola, and Pebblebee, Google's Pixel Tag is now available for purchase. First announced in August, the Pixel Tag is designed to work with Google's tracking network and app that was renamed the Find Hub last year. The Pixel Tag is priced similar to Apple's AirTag

India to provide grant for expansion of Sri Lanka's emergency ambulance service. transcript.title: Across India
transcript.text: Turning to the big national stories. Parl panel drops NCR air pollution from agenda, Cong's Maken raises objection. As the Capital chokes under the haze of polluted air, a Parliamentary panel's decision to drop the issue without citing any reason from the meeting agenda for Nov 17 has evoked a sharp reaction from Congress' Rajya MP Ajay Maken who is a member of the standing committee on home affairs. Being underweight with high BP can be a problem too: Study. While obesity with hypertension is the most widely recognised high-risk category, a recent study has shown that being underweight with elevated blood pressure or hypertension may also be a high-risk sub-group in Asian populations. EC: Code of conduct applies to retd govt officials in state jobs. EC Tuesday directed that the "political neutrality" provision of model code of conduct (MCC) will henceforth apply not just to serving govt employees in poll-bound states but also to retired govt officials and staffers attached, employed or re-employed by state govts. Unesco: Women ahead in higher edu, but rural-urban gap hits schoolgirls. India has made substantial progress in closing the gender gap in education, with women now outpacing men in higher education. Days after talks with NC 'rebels', Farooq moots advisory groups for ministers. Days after 15 of 25 "rebel" National Conference (NC) legislators called for replacing all eight J and K cabinet ministers and removing CM Omar Abdullah's adviser, party president Farooq Abdullah announced Tuesday an informal advisory group of MLAs for each minister. Ladakh hill council polls on Dec 4, protests erupt over winter timing. Kargil shut down Tuesday and political groups in Leh threatened an agitation after Ladakh announced Dec 4 elections to its eight autonomous hill development councils, rejecting demands to avoid holding the polls during the harsh winter months. Evening newswrap: Sonia Gandhi's memoir sparks row; India condemns Chinese vloggers; MEA reacts to US midterm results, and more. Sonia Gandhi shared her surprise at Pranab Mukherjee's ambition for the prime minister role in 2010. His daughter Sharmishtha questioned the surprise, expressing that such aspirations are valid in politics. India condemned an anti-India campaign by Chinese vloggers in Dhaka, urging the Bangladesh government to act against it. The country also expressed its continued bipartisan support for ties with the US after recent midterm elections. CPCB explains why official AQI is capped at 500 despite private apps showing higher readings. The Central Pollution Control Board on Tuesday defended its air quality monitoring methodology, explaining why official AQI readings are capped at 500 even as private monitoring apps reported levels as high as 1,800 in Delhi after Diwali. Chemical-free crackers: RSS chief extols traditional Diwali practices as severe pollution chokes Delhi. RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat noted that firecrackers used in earlier times were free of harmful chemicals and helped eliminate insects, while lighting ghee-fuelled lamps served to purify the air.Addressing a gathering in Nagpur, Bhagwat called for an environment-friendly Diwali, asserting that traditional festive practices were deeply rooted in science.The RSS chief's comments come at a time when air quality in Delhi and several other metropolitan cities has deteriorated to the "poor" and "severe" categories due to the bursting of firecrackers."There was science behind these traditional practices," he said, invoking the phrase "Vatavaran shuddh, jeevan shuddh" (a clean environment leads to a pure life).He further said that "dharma" serves to unite society and that women often possess a deeper understanding of it than men.Bhagwat noted that Diwali is celebrated over five days across the world, bringing joy to Indians as people come together to exchange greetings and good wishes. 'Bogus movement led by bogus leader': Union minister takes jibe at Rahul over ethanol blending row. Union minister Pralhad Joshi on Tuesday stepped up his attack on Congress over ethanol blending in petrol row and accused it of misleading the public over the issue. 2008 CRPF camp attack convict shot dead by unknown gunman in UP. An unknown gunman shot dead Mohammad Sharif, an accused linked to the 2008 CRPF camp attack, on Tuesday.

transcript.title: Around the world
transcript.text: And finally, here is what is happening around the world. US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now. Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year. Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest. Supporters of Sheikh Hasina want her to return from exile in India. Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned. The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.
